name: resource-groups
description: Resource Groups lets you organize Amazon Web Services resources such as Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud instances, Amazon Relational Database Service databases, and Amazon Simple Storage Service buckets into groups using criteria that you define as tags.

subcommands.name: cancel-tag-sync-task
subcommands.description: Cancels the specified tag-sync task.

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a resource group with the specified name and description.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified resource group.

subcommands.name: get-account-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current status of optional features in Resource Groups.

subcommands.name: get-group
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified resource group.

subcommands.name: get-group-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the service configuration associated with the specified resource group.

subcommands.name: get-group-query
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource query associated with the specified resource group.

subcommands.name: get-tag-sync-task
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified tag-sync task.

subcommands.name: get-tags
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags that are associated with a resource group, specified by an Amazon resource name (ARN).

subcommands.name: group-resources
subcommands.description: Adds the specified resources to the specified group.

subcommands.name: list-group-resources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon resource names (ARNs) of the resources that are members of a specified resource group.

subcommands.name: list-grouping-statuses
subcommands.description: Returns the status of the last grouping or ungrouping action for each resource in the specified application group.

subcommands.name: list-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of existing Resource Groups in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tag-sync-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tag-sync tasks.

subcommands.name: put-group-configuration
subcommands.description: Attaches a service configuration to the specified group.

subcommands.name: search-resources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon Web Services resource identifiers that matches the specified query.

subcommands.name: start-tag-sync-task
subcommands.description: Creates a new tag-sync task to onboard and sync resources tagged with a specific tag key-value pair to an application.

subcommands.name: tag
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a resource group with the specified Amazon resource name (ARN).

subcommands.name: ungroup-resources
subcommands.description: Removes the specified resources from the specified group.

subcommands.name: untag
subcommands.description: Deletes tags from a specified resource group.

subcommands.name: update-account-settings
subcommands.description: Turns on or turns off optional features in Resource Groups.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Updates the description for an existing group.

subcommands.name: update-group-query
subcommands.description: Updates the resource query of a group.
